changes.summary: AgentZap's public pricing page changed from per-call bundles to per-minute bundles. The day the page switched is not known. This entry compares the 14 February 2026 archive with the pricing page recorded in the cost model on 6 November 2026.
changes.before: Archive of agentzap.ai/pricing on 14 February 2026: Starter $79/month for 50 calls, then $2.00/call; Basic $199/month for 150 calls, then $1.80/call; Pro $499/month for 500 calls, then $1.50/call; Enterprise custom. That page said 24/7 answering and appointment scheduling were included.
changes.after: Pricing page checked 6 November 2026 and stored in src/data/cost-models.json: Starter $109/month for 150 minutes, then $0.85/min, plus a $499 setup fee; Professional $295/month for 450 minutes, then $0.75/min, plus $499 setup; Business $899/month for 1,500 minutes, then $0.70/min, plus $499 setup; Managed $899/month for 1,500 minutes with setup included and no overage rate printed; Enterprise custom. The unit is minutes, not calls.

sources.title: agentzap.ai/pricing as recorded in the cost model

changes.summary: OnCrew's public pricing changed from per-call bundles to per-minute bundles. OnCrew told us the move happened in late October 2026. This entry compares the listing we had recorded on 4 November 2026 with oncrew.ai/pricing checked on 12 November 2026.
changes.before: Listing recorded 4 November 2026 from a third-party roundup: Starter $49/mo (100 calls); Pro $149; Multi-Truck $349. Billing model: per answered call.
changes.after: Pricing page checked 12 November 2026: Starter $49/mo with 150 minutes of answered calls, then $0.49 per extra minute; Pro $149/mo with 200 minutes, then $0.99 per extra minute; Multi-Truck $349/mo with 500 minutes, then $0.99 per extra minute. No setup fee. 14-day free trial with no card required.

sources.title: Source of the 4 November 2026 listing (per-call wording)

changes.summary: Abby Connect folded its separate AI Receptionist plans into its combined Human + AI plans. The cheapest plan with AI answering moved from $99/mo to $164/mo for 50 Abby Minutes, and an AI-answered minute counts as half, so that plan covers up to 100 minutes of AI answering. The day the page changed is not known. This entry compares the 14 July 2026 archive of abby.com/pricing with the live pages read on 13 November 2026.
changes.before: Archive of abby.com/pricing on 14 July 2026: separate AI Receptionist plans, Starter $99 for up to 50 minutes, Essential $165 for 100, Professional $299 for 200, Growth $690 for 500. Human Receptionist plans started at $329/mo for 100 minutes.
changes.after: abby.com/pricing and abby.com/products/ai-receptionist read 13 November 2026: one set of Human + AI plans, Starter $164/mo for 50 Abby Minutes (up to 100 minutes of AI answering), Essential $329/mo for 100, Professional $599/mo for 200, Growth $1,380/mo for 500. No separate $99 AI plan is listed.

changes.summary: Viva AI added an Unlimited plan, priced per provider, next to its credit plans. It is $350/mo for the first provider plus $150/mo for each added provider; the Gold, Platinum and Diamond credit plans are unchanged. The day the plan appeared is not known. This entry compares the 30 July 2026 archive of getviva.ai with the live page read on 13 November 2026.
changes.before: Archive of getviva.ai on 30 July 2026: credit plans only. Gold $349/mo with 4,000 credits, Platinum $899/mo with 7,000, Diamond $1,199/mo with 12,000.
changes.after: getviva.ai read 13 November 2026: the same Gold $349, Platinum $899 and Diamond $1,199 credit plans, plus an Unlimited plan at $350/mo for the first provider and +$150/mo per added provider, with unlimited AI credits. An optional Full Platform add-on is $300 per location per month.
